probable_cause: Label damaged, wrapped, or printed below 300 dpi
Two labels on one tube or overlapping label edges
Short-cap 5 mL tubes below minimum sensor window
resolution: See VBB-0038 advisory; use tube adapter SP1-ADP-05 or upgrade to SP-1r2
notes: Root cause of the 2025 barcode jam reports

probable_cause: Overtightened cap or cap glued by dried sample
resolution: Manually decap; inspect gripper jaws for wear
Open lid and clear cap; run Gripper Home

probable_cause: Tube tilted in carrier, short-cap tube geometry, or feed pawl wear
resolution: Clear jam per SOP-VBS-003; replace feed mechanism SP1-MEC-140 if recurring
notes: Frequency drops ~90% on SP-1r2 feed assembly

probable_cause: Home flag misaligned after jam recovery
resolution: Run Gripper Home from Service menu

probable_cause: Pipette seal wear or air in syringe
resolution: Run Syringe Prime; verify with gravimetric check per SOP-VBS-009

probable_cause: Tip rack empty or tip seated crooked
resolution: Reload tip rack; check rack seating

probable_cause: Capacitive sensor contaminated or highly lipaemic sample
resolution: Clean sensor; enable Lipaemic Mode in run settings

probable_cause: Rack RFID unread or rack inserted at angle
RS-232 cable fault or baud mismatch
Network change or analyser IP reassigned by DHCP
resolution: Assign static IP or DHCP reservation to analyser

probable_cause: SP-1 firmware older than analyser firmware requirement
resolution: Update SP-1 firmware to 2.3.0 or later for VeriScan FW 4.3.x

probable_cause: Lid opened mid-cycle or interlock switch failure
resolution: Close lid; if error persists with lid closed replace interlock SP1-ELE-018

probable_cause: Cycle aborted or insufficient RGT-CL volume
